name: slurm-deck
description: Slurm Deck — a hardened, menu-driven TUI gateway for shared SLURM/GPU clusters. Includes the slurm-deck-installer skill for a guided, checkpointed install.

plugins.name: slurm-deck-installer
plugins.description: Guided, checkpointed installer for the Slurm Deck — walks through prerequisites, site.env, install.sh, admin sudoers, GPU-host SSH, service verification, first-admin provisioning, and optional GPU sharing config, pausing for explicit confirmation before every root/sudo/system-mutating step.
